description: This file contains unit tests for the DefaultFailureHandler class in the Eclipse Hono project. It verifies the behavior of the request failure handling logic, such as response status, response body content, and response end conditions.

classes.name: DefaultFailureHandlerTest
classes.description: Unit tests for DefaultFailureHandler class, testing response handling in failure scenarios.

methods.name: testHandlerDetectsEndedResponse
methods.description: Verifies that the handler does not process a response if it has already ended.

methods.name: testHandlerSucceedsForExceptionsWithoutMessage
methods.description: Checks that the handler sets a 500 status and empty body when failure has no message.

methods.name: testHandlerWritesDetailMessageToBody
methods.description: Verifies that the handler writes the failure's detail message to the response body.

methods.name: testHandlerWritesDetailMessageAndErrorCodeToBody
methods.description: Checks that the handler writes both the error code and message for ClientErrorException.

methods.name: testHandlerWithFailedContextAndEmptyFailure
methods.description: Ensures that if the failure is null, the handler sets the response status code and ends the response without writing a body.
